questions.question: How is a tetrahedron the same as a square-based pyramid, and how is it different?
questions.expected_answer: Both are pyramids, with triangular faces meeting at an apex. A tetrahedron has a triangular base, so all 4 faces are triangles, while a square-based pyramid has a square base and 4 triangles.

questions.question: Why is a cube a special rectangular prism?
questions.expected_answer: A rectangular prism has 6 rectangular faces. A cube also has 6 faces, and they are all squares, which are special rectangles.

questions.question: What is the difference between a prism and a pyramid?
questions.expected_answer: A prism has two identical bases joined by rectangles. A pyramid has one base and triangular faces that meet at a point called the apex.
